verdict.rationale: GitLab's own docs say security scans can be scheduled to run at regular intervals, which is a genuine recurring schedule rather than a one-off on-demand run. The evidence only covers security scans, though, not general jobs or workflows. CI/CD pipelines are mentioned, but only as running on commits or merge requests, with no recurring trigger documented. missing for 10: documented general-purpose recurring scheduling for arbitrary CI/CD jobs or workflows, details of schedule configuration (intervals, cron syntax, API/CLI control), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: you can run security scans on demand, or schedule them to run at regular intervals.
Planning, source control, and CI/CD in one platform.
